deadline.value: The PhD page gives no application deadline.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not mandatory but are highly recommended.
gre_general.quote: Although the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores are not currently mandatory, they are highly recommended.

gre_subject.value: No Electrical Engineering subject test exists, and the page does not mention one.

supervisor.value: The department admits PhD applicants only with a TA or RA offer from a faculty member.
supervisor.quote: The ECE Department can only accept PhD applicants with faculty member support in the form of either a Teaching Assistantship or Research Assistantship.

funding.value: Admitted PhD students must already hold a TA or RA position, so admission means funding.
funding.quote: The ECE Department can only accept PhD applicants with faculty member support in the form of either a Teaching Assistantship or Research Assistantship.

entry_route.value: A master's is typical but not required; applicants with exemplary bachelor's records may be considered.
entry_route.quote: a master’s degree is not a mandatory prerequisite for admission to the PhD program.
